node.statement: By def-compressed-corner, u_T=Co_T(T) and there are a universal k<infinity and a universal validity threshold for which ||Co_T-L_T R_T||<=k*(delta+epsilon). By def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra, M_1 tensor A=A is an epsilon-C*-algebra, so its defining multiplication axiom is ||XY||<=(1+epsilon)||X||||Y||. This proves item (ii).
